title: The Latest Crier for Jan 24, 2026
items:
Friday Night Flight - Paper Airplane Contest - Maytag - 8 to 10pm

Stop by the Maytag Atrium Friday night for a little paper airplane challenge! Let's see if you got what it takes to make, launch and pilot the best paper airplane on campus in the following categories: 
-longest flight 

-coolest design 

-straightest flier & more! 

*Prizes for each category!

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The Free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 1/25/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu.

EnVision Vision Board Night

Join us for Vision Board Night and kick off the semester by creating your own vision board. All materials will be provided. We’ll be in the Maytag Atrium on Saturday, the 24th, from 7–9 PM . We can’t wait to see you there!

Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement. 

Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Need accommodations for your spring classes?

Welcome back! 
If you have a disability and need accommodations for your spring classes, get in touch with the Coordinator for ADA Accommodations (Amy Young) at ada@central.edu or 641-628-5296.

Ride to campus needed

Looking for someone reliable this semester, to pick me at home and drop me at Weller center and drop back at home after classes. I am visually impaired and need a drive. Pick up time MWF 9.30 AM from hometo Weller and at noon from Weller and for TuThu 9 AM pick up from home to Weller and at 11 AM pick up from Weller to home. Willing to pay for the rides- $15 per day. If anyone is available and interested please email me at mohanv1@central.edu

Annual Student Wellness & Fitness Fair with Top Shelf, Big Acai & More!

Win *Top Shelf Nutrition* for the Semester AND a Big Acai Prize Package worth $100! Stop by the Student Wellness & Fitness Fair - Tuesday, Jan. 27th 6:30-8:00 pm in Maytag. 

We will have 20+ campus services and community resources with special student offers, fun freebies, and great information to help you achieve your wellness goals and live your best life in 2026!

HISTORY CLUB WELCOME BACK. MON. JAN. 26th

The History Club biweekly dinners are starting up again! Join us Monday, January 26th in a Market sideroom for dinner, news, and a game. We have lots of ideas for the semester! Get your dinner and come join us. 5:30 - 7:00pm. Come and go as you can! Everyone welcome!
